mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment (user_id, slot_id, package_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{slotId}, #{packageId}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM appointment WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM appointment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE appointment SET report_url = #{reportUrl} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING'

SELECT a.id AS appointment_id, a.user_id AS user_id, u.phone AS phone, p.name AS package_name, s.appoint_date AS appoint_date, s.time_range AS time_range FROM appointment a JOIN appointment_slot s ON a.slot_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 JOIN appointment_package p ON a.package_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 JOIN `user` u ON a.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') AND s.appoint_date = #{date}
